items.title: Charles River Laboratories Recent $470 Million Deal an 'Attractive Strategic Addition,' Analyst Says
items.summary: Charles River Laboratories International Inc. (NYSE:CRL) on Monday agreed to acquire the bioanalysis and drug metabolism and pharmacokinetics (DMPK) operations of Frontage Holdings Corporation in Exton, Pennsylvania, for approximately $470 million in cash. The transaction also includes up to $75 million in performance-based earnout payments, positioning Charles River to capture expanding biopharmaceutical demand.
